title: Pawn input state fix: every party pawn, fix on vs off (DPC 0.9.177-dev6)
intro: Runs by itself on the test bench. The robot plays each party pawn with the input state fix on, then off: run, light x3, heavy, hold L2, skill 1, skill 2, jump. Then co-op player 2 with the fix on. Compare the on/off rows per vocation.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.job: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and s.pawn_job or 0
probes.fix: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.cfg.pawn_prev_state ~= false
probes.pf: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pipfix_n or 0
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''
probes.n1: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc, 1) or ''
probes.sk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.atk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_AttackState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.v: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.active and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.speed(pc, 'played') or 0
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
